// Security.JwtSecret: Deliberately absent -- root-caused live (2026-09-29): this used to ship a literal placeholder string here. Since it's the BASE appsettings.json (loaded under every environment, including Production, before any environment-specific file), that placeholder was a real, non-empty configured value everywhere it wasn't explicitly overridden -- so Program.cs's own 'auto-generate if unset' logic never actually fired, and every install that didn't know to override this exact key shared the same publicly-known-from-GitHub JWT signing secret. Omitting it here lets that auto-generation do its job.
